patterns: APPSC asks direct one-line facts: AP ranks first in fish & shrimp production, highest inland fish landings (2019-20), largest district by food-crop area.

Fisheries welfare is asked as statement sets (Matsyakara Bharosa ban relief, Fisheries University district, diesel subsidy, ex-gratia) and number-of-beneficiaries items from the Socio-Economic Survey.
Irrigation is asked via CCA classes (minor <2,000 ha) and main source (canals in AP vs wells/tube wells in India) - a recurring trap.
District superlatives (largest food-crop area, best GDDP) come from APSES annexures; the app has few such items.
App MCQs lean on dated survey numbers and 2026 news (El Nino, tariffs) far more than APPSC does; keep stems direct.
